title: The New Covenant
description: The Lord promises through Jeremiah to make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah. Unlike the covenant made at the Exodus, which the people broke, the Lord will put his law within them and write it on their hearts. He will be their God, and they will be his people. No longer will each teach their neighbor or say to one another, 'Know the Lord,' for all will know him, from the least of them to the greatest. For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more. [ref:Jer 31:31-34|Jeremiah 31:31-34]
